purpose: Fresh independent U3 meaning reserve after the temporal-status repair; freeze bytes before request export or generation, then mark exposed after first run.
evaluationOrder: Freeze corpus and rubric before exporting production requests. Grade model output, policy readiness, and semantic preservation separately.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: A draft or safe recovery preserves recipient, time direction, dates, amounts, units, identifiers, URL/path/flag bytes, negation, uncertainty, conditions, and the difference between completed and proposed actions.
semanticCriteria.critical: Changed or missing factual value, recipient, restriction, conditional, uncertainty, exact technical literal, or action status; fabricated completion or send claim; unsupported content reaching review.
semanticCriteria.minor: Style or wording weakness with all requested meaning intact.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 20 cases have zero critical semantic errors and zero exact-literal violations. A safe rejection is recorded separately from a successful draft.
